lines.x: SQM reported its Q3 profit tripled, driven by surging lithium prices and solid demand, though it warned of lower prices ahead in the fourth quarter.
SQM reported a 288% increase in profits to $1.57 billion for the first nine months of 2026, though Q3 results fell short of analyst expectations, causing the IPSA index to drop.
Chile's economy shrank 1.1% in the third quarter of 2026, driven down by a 17.7% contraction in mining activity.
Chile's gross domestic product fell 1.8% in the third quarter, registering its biggest drop since 2020.
